body:
## Changelog
### Fixes
* 40dcf243fbdda2b8dc912aa02f7ddb2219b96f6b fix: Fix keepassxcAttachment template func in cache password mode
* b703d469002d4e8fe269718917d065db90d22afe fix: Ignore entries in tar archives that resolve to the current dir
* e2ca6e3253febbc454e8f8951c9dd77aa227ae07 fix: Fix re-add command when adding individual files in an exact_ dir
* 26e99d554e2f78f3878c047524b238fee266e408 fix: Don't read .chezmoidata files in external_ dirs
